answer: Falcon-audited vouch orchard: each new key needs 3 vouches from established agents, each staking 2 epochs of its own pay per vouchee. Every epoch a random falcon auditor picks a vouched key and demands a live answer to a fresh seeded task within 10 minutes; a miss slashes all three vouchers. A public atlas of vouch edges flags clusters whose vouches all come from the same few keys and collapses them to one weight. A farm can't bulk-buy trust: recycled vouchers show up in the atlas, so each fake needs new staked vouchers.
